examples.title: Basic — merge, watermark, metadata
examples.description: Merge two PDFs, stamp a DRAFT watermark, and set the title/author. The 'hello world' of OPW.

examples.title: Batch — one workflow over many files
examples.description: A glob input runs the whole workflow once per matched PDF, writing one output per file.

examples.title: Compare — diff two PDF revisions
examples.description: Side-by-side visual + text diff of two document versions as one shareable diff.pdf.

examples.title: Extract links — every URL from a folder of PDFs
examples.description: Pull every hyperlink out of a whole folder into one links.json + links.csv — clickable link annotations (URL, page, anchor text) plus bare URLs printed in the text. Needs the Python backend.

examples.title: Fill forms — government forms from your records
examples.description: Mapped forms (W-9, 1040, I-9, DS-11…) filled from a local, gitignored people.yaml. Templates download on first fill.

examples.title: Merge a folder — combine every PDF into one
examples.description: Point a glob at a folder (input/*.pdf) and merge every matching PDF into one, in sorted filename order — no need to list the files.

examples.title: Operations reference — every operation
examples.description: One ready-to-adapt example workflow for every OPW operation, grouped by category, with a shared sample.pdf. A gallery to learn from.

examples.title: Page stats — profile a PDF before you extract or OCR it
examples.description: text_report on a deliberately mixed document: per-page size/characters/images/class, text coverage, which pages are image-only vs blank vs oversized — plus the workflow to author for it (OCR only pages 5-7, not all 10).

examples.title: Redact identity — permanently remove PII
examples.description: De-identify a document: permanently delete a name, address, email, phone, SSN, and IP with auto_redact, then rasterize so nothing hidden can survive.

examples.title: Split — one PDF into many by page range
examples.description: Slice a PDF into separate files by explicit page ranges, or every N pages. Runs fully offline.

examples.title: Split invoices — burst a batch into per-invoice PDFs
examples.description: Detect invoice boundaries from page text and emit one named PDF per invoice, plus a _manifest.csv.

examples.title: Variables & conditionals — one workflow, many jobs
examples.description: Declare vars and reference them with ${name} in params and the output path; override them at run time to re-target the same workflow. A when: guard runs an op only when a predicate over document facts (pages, encrypted, …) or vars is true.
